notes: All 22,370 rows from the official Panini CSV export are retained, including all original columns, literal card-set parallel names and SEQUENCE values. Empty numbering is not an estimate. Pack odds are absent from this export. Product year does not establish a release date. This export was observed in the official interface on 2026-10-14; that observation is not a release date.
